title: feat(instantsearch): hydrate search client
body:
This draft PR shows a proof of concept of hydrating the search client with initial results obtained during server-side rendering, so that the initial client-side request hits the cache.

The code is adapted from the implementation that worked in React InstantSearch v6: https://github.com/algolia/react-instantsearch/blob/master/packages/react-instantsearch-core/src/core/createInstantSearchManager.js#L329.

**results**:

fixes #5864
fixes #5839
FX-2647
